title: Website Development
short: Clear, fast, mobile-friendly websites that explain what you do and make it easy for customers to contact you.
metaDescription: Saturn Technologies builds business websites, corporate websites, landing pages and portfolio sites that are fast, responsive and easy to manage.
intro: Your website is often the first thing a customer sees. We design and build websites that present your business clearly, load quickly on phones and desktops, and make it simple for visitors to get in touch.
included: Page structure and content layout planned around your business goals
Responsive design that works on mobile, tablet and desktop
Contact forms and enquiry buttons that reach you
Basic on-page search engine setup (titles, descriptions, sitemap)
Handover so you know how your site is managed
goodFor: Businesses launching their first website
Companies replacing an outdated or slow website
Professionals who need a portfolio or personal brand site
Campaigns that need a focused landing page

title: Custom Web Application Development
short: Software built around how your business actually works, from internal dashboards to customer portals.
metaDescription: Custom software development: admin dashboards, customer portals, booking systems, inventory tools and business automation built for your workflow.
intro: When off-the-shelf software does not fit, we build web applications tailored to your process. We start by understanding how your team works today, then design software that removes manual effort instead of adding to it.
included: Requirement discussion and a written scope before development starts
User accounts, roles and permissions where needed
Dashboards, forms, search and reporting designed for daily use
Integration with tools you already use, where an integration is available
Testing before launch and support after launch
goodFor: Teams managing work in spreadsheets and messages
Businesses that take bookings or appointments
Companies tracking stock, orders or customers
Organisations that need a portal for customers or staff

title: E-commerce Development
short: Online stores that present your products well and take payments securely.
metaDescription: E-commerce website development: online stores, product catalogues, shopping carts and payment gateway integration for growing businesses.
intro: We build online stores that make it easy for customers to browse, choose and pay, and easy for you to manage products and orders.
included: Product catalogue with categories, images and search
Shopping cart and checkout flow
Integration with a payment gateway of your choice, subject to the gateway's own approval process
Order management for your team
Mobile-first layouts for shoppers on phones
goodFor: Retailers moving online for the first time
Brands that sell through social media and want their own store
Businesses that need a product catalogue with enquiries rather than checkout

title: Web Hosting Solutions
short: Hosting, domain management and business email, set up and supported by the team that builds your site.
metaDescription: Website hosting services with domain management, business email and website migration, supported by the same team that builds your site.
intro: Keep your website, domain and email in one place with one team to call. We can host sites we build, move an existing site to us, and help you manage your domain and business email.
included: Website hosting on one of our plans
Help registering, renewing and managing your domain name
Business email address setup
Migration of an existing website to our hosting
Technical support for hosting issues
goodFor: Businesses that want one point of contact for site and hosting
Owners who want help with domain and email setup
Anyone moving away from hosting that is slow or unsupported

title: UI/UX Design
short: Interfaces that are easy to understand and pleasant to use on every screen size.
metaTitle: UI/UX Design for Websites and Web Apps
metaDescription: UI/UX design services: website interface design, responsive layouts and user experience improvements for websites and web applications.
intro: Good design makes a product easier to use and a business easier to trust. We design interfaces around what your visitors and users are trying to do.
included: Layouts and visual design consistent with your brand
Responsive designs for phones, tablets and desktops
Review of an existing site's navigation, forms and flows with specific recommendations
Design that is ready to be built, so nothing is lost between design and development
goodFor: Businesses whose site looks dated or is confusing to use
Startups preparing a first product interface
Teams that want a design review before investing in development

title: IT Support and Maintenance
short: Keep your website and software running smoothly after launch.
metaTitle: Website Maintenance and IT Support Services
metaDescription: Website maintenance and IT support: updates, bug fixing, technical assistance and performance improvements for websites and web applications.
intro: A website needs care after launch. We help with updates, fixes, content changes and performance, so small problems do not turn into big ones.
included: Fixing bugs and broken functionality
Content and design updates
Technical assistance when something is not working
Reviews of speed and performance, with improvements
goodFor: Businesses without an in-house technical person
Sites that were built by someone else and need ongoing care
Owners who want a dependable contact when something breaks
